text: Provides SDKs/support for over a dozen platforms for error instrumentation
quote: Rollbar supports over a dozen platforms, and our community has built many more.

text: Groups duplicate error occurrences into a single Item automatically
quote: Rollbar aggregates _Occurrences_ caused by the same error into _Items_ that represent application issues.

text: Lets you define custom fingerprinting rules to control how errors are grouped
quote: If our default grouping algorithm is separating occurrences that you would rather have combined or vice versa, then you can set up Custom Fingerprinting Rules.

text: Allows merging multiple items into one group for cleaner metrics
quote: Item merging allows you to combine multiple items into one 'group' for easier management and more accurate metrics.

text: Stack traces show original source filename, line number, method name, and code location
quote: Stack traces will contain the original source filename, line number, method name, and code coordinates

text: Shows which code version/release is throwing a given exception
quote: Rollbar allows you to see which versions of your code are throwing exceptions.

text: Deploy/release notifications unlock additional debugging features tied to releases
quote: If you notify Rollbar every time you deploy or release your app, you'll unlock several features that will help your debugging process.

text: Sends real-time alerts via email and various messaging/incident-management integrations
quote: Rollbar supports email and many messaging and incident management tools where your team can get notified about errors and important events by real-time alerts.

text: Native Slack connection for receiving alert notifications
quote: Click **Connect with Slack**

text: Integrates with PagerDuty to create, update, and resolve incidents
quote: Rollbar can create, update, and resolve Incidents in PagerDuty.

text: Supports outbound webhooks to push data to arbitrary external services
quote: You can set up webhooks to make Rollbar push data to any arbitrary external service.

text: Items have lifecycle statuses: Active, Resolved, Muted, Archived
quote: There are four statuses: Active, Resolved, Muted, and Archived.

text: Items can be assigned a specific owner for triage accountability
quote: Items can have a specific Rollbar user designated as the Owner of an item.

text: Offers a RESTful API exposing most system data
quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system.

text: API supports filtering items by severity level and environment
quote: Get the first page of items that are error or critical, in the production environment

text: Newly created API tokens are encrypted and not retrievable after creation for security
quote: Newly created tokens will now be encrypted and will no longer be accessible via the UI or API after creation.

text: Resolve AI agent analyzes a production error and generates a pull request fix
quote: Resolve is an AI agent in Rollbar that takes a production error and produces a pull request you can review.

text: Provides an MCP server implementing the Model Context Protocol for AI tool integration
quote: An MCP server is a component of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which is an open standard for connecting AI systems with external data sources and tools.

text: Data retention period is customizable on all paid plans
quote: Rollbar data retention period can be customized on all paid plans.

text: Tracks which users are affected by each error
quote: Rollbar can track which of your People (users) are affected by each error.

text: Plans include capped event/session quotas (e.g., 5K occurrences + 1K sessions)
quote: 5K occurrences + 1K sessions

text: Free tier offers 5K events per month with a 14-day full-access trial
quote: 5K free events per monthEasy and quick installation14-day full access trial

text: Captures a telemetry timeline of breadcrumb events to aid debugging client-side JS issues
quote: The telemetry timeline provides a list of “breadcrumbs” events that can help developers understand and fix problems in their client-side javascript.

text: Advanced search lets you filter items by many different properties
quote: Advanced search: Filter items by many different properties.

text: Session Replay beta captures and replays user sessions around errors
quote: Session Replay is now available in beta! This feature captures and replays user sessions around errors
